latest_release.body:
# Release notes - UniOffice v2.15.0
This release contains new features, improvements and bug fixes.

### New Features

- [US-1713](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1713) Password protection and encryption for Office documents: open and save password-encrypted DOCX, XLSX and PPTX files through `OpenWithOptions`, `ReadWithOptions`, `SaveWithOptions` and `SaveToFileWithOptions` (reads agile and standard AES encryption, writes agile AES-256), salted SHA-512 hashes for spreadsheet sheet and workbook protection, and a Word Restrict Editing API on `Settings.DocumentProtection()`. Opening with a wrong password returns `ErrIncorrectPassword`, and an unsupported scheme returns `ErrUnsupportedEncryption`
- [US-1748](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1748) PPTX slide transitions API: `Slide.SetTransition`, `Slide.Transition` and `Slide.RemoveTransition`, covering 21 transition effects plus a timing-only transition, with direction, speed, automatic advance and click advance
- [US-1800](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1800) PPTX hyperlinks: external links on text runs, text boxes and images, slide-to-slide jumps (`Slide.AddHyperlink`, `Slide.AddSlideJump`), slide-show navigation jumps (first, last, next, previous, last viewed, end show) and tooltips
- [US-1799](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1799) Spreadsheet row and column grouping: `Sheet.GroupRows`/`GroupColumns`, `SetOutlineLevel`/`SetCollapsed` on rows and columns, and `Sheet.SetSummaryBelow`/`SetSummaryRight`. Also adds data validation prompt and error messages (`SetPrompt`, `SetError`), lock/unlock for each of the 14 sheet protection flags, strike and superscript/subscript for rich text, and hyperlink tooltips, display text and links within the workbook (`Cell.AddInternalHyperlink`)

### Improvements

- [US-1836](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1836) PPTX slides, layouts and masters keep their `mc:AlternateContent` transitions through open and save, and animation timing values (`dur`, `delay`, `repeatCount`, `tm`, `dir`) are no longer blanked on save
- [US-1063](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1063) DOCX to PDF wrapping text around anchored images the way Word does, including images anchored later in the document than the text they overlap
- [US-1978](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1978) UniPDF dependency update to v5.2.0
- [US-1946](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1946) `golang.org/x/image` update to v0.45.0 and `golang.org/x/text` update to v0.41.0, fixing reachable security advisories (GO-2026-5032, GO-2026-5062, GO-2026-5066, GO-2026-5970). The minimum Go version stays at 1.25.0
- [US-1941](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1941) Test golden files are no longer rewritten when only zip metadata such as timestamps changes
- [US-1980](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1980) Render tests now detect changes in black content, and the OpenXML SDK validation gate runs and fails in CI
- [US-2057](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-2057) CI test runs no longer fail because of too many license check-ins
- [US-2028](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-2028) Release packaging fix for generic declarations the source obfuscator cannot handle, with a CI check that rejects new ones

### Bug Fixes

- [US-1838](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1838) Metered license state file written in place, so parallel processes sharing an API key failed with "ciphertext too short" or "invalid data" and overwrote each other's document counts fix. The file is now written atomically and locked across processes
- [US-2041](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-2041) `SaveToFile`, `SaveToFileWithOptions` and `Presentation.SaveToFileAsTemplate` ignoring the error from closing the written file, and `Presentation.Save` ignoring the zip writer's close error, so a truncated file was reported as saved fix
- [US-1801](https://unidoc.atlassian.net/browse/US-1801) Open and save corrupting packages whose media parts are ren
